title: Introduce proportional spacing anchors and ambient shadow system for dataviz and forms
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: Our current token set exposes fixed spacing steps and a binary shadow system that leads to inconsistent rhythm across data tables, charts, and dense form layouts. This causes visual noise when mixed components (charts + tables + controls) appear together at different breakpoints. Goals: 1) Replace fixed step spacing with a proportional anchor system that scales predictably across container widths and density modes. 2) Introduce an ambient shadow/elevation system with microsteps optimized for datavis and form fields to reduce perceived layering while preserving accessible contrast. 3) Deliver token names and migration guidance so engineering can adopt without breaking existing styles. Scope: tokens (spacing anchors, radius anchors, shadow presets), updated component examples (Table, Chart card, Form row, Button), migration checklist, updated docs and Figma library artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: New spacing anchors defined (anchor-0..anchor-6) with proportional mapping to px for small/medium/large density
Shadow presets created: ambient-xxs, ambient-xs, ambient-sm, ambient-md and interactive-elevation-sm/md, with tokenized blur/offset/alpha
Design tokens documented in Figma and tokens JSON with code-friendly naming convention
Updated component specs: Table row spacing, Chart card padding, Form control grouping reflect new anchors
A migration guide with automated codemod suggestions and a fallback compatibility layer for older tokens
Accessibility review: contrast and focus states validated with new elevation tokens and spacing for keyboard targets
design_decisions: Use proportional anchors instead of absolute steps to avoid repeated token overrides when changing container width
Base proportional scale on a 4pt system but expose anchors (anchor-0..6) to map to 4/8/12/16/24/40 px equivalents at medium density
Ambient shadows are preferred over directional drop shadows for dataviz surfaces to reduce directional noise when charts and cards are tiled
Interactive elevation tokens include slightly higher alpha and offset to maintain affordance for buttons and floating controls
Do not remove legacy tokens immediately; provide compatibility shim and plan deprecation over two release cycles
tasks: Audit existing components that reference spacing and elevation tokens
Create Figma components with updated tokens and demos for Table, Chart card, Form row, Button variants
Author tokens JSON and publish to the tokens registry
Write migration guide and codemod examples for engineering
Run accessibility checks on updated components and iterate with PM/Engineering
Create rollout plan with canary path in Console component library and runtime feature flag
